address: Grand View Resort Beitou, 30 Youya Road, Beitou District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: The food alone would be reason enough to visit this resort, breath-taking mountain views and hot spring baths aside. The experienced chef reimagines Taiwanese classics with novel twists. His strikingly styled appetiser, osmanthus white jade, is radish carved into flowers and steeped in home-brewed osmanthus wine, imparting floral notes, a crunchy texture, and a sweet-and-sour harmony. Local wines and teas allow diners to taste the full scope of Taiwan’s terroir.
